title: ‘It felt like forever’: passengers recount mass stabbing on Cambridgeshire train
summary: Some initially assumed the commotion was a Halloween prank, but soon realised something awful was unfolding Cambridgeshire train stabbing: latest updates Two men in police custody after mass stabbing on LNER train Explainer: Cambridgeshire train attack – what we know so far The Saturday evening train to London was crowded but on time. Those heading to the capital had less than an hour left as it pulled out of Peterborough station, at shortly after 7.30pm. But the unremarkable scene soon turned to horror, as bloodied passengers fled through carriages and sought refuge in toilet cubicles. Continue reading...
